text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back after finishing our errands,
Cesario mentioned wanting to buy some seasoning, so as we headed to the store—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ah, the one over there is...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Cesario-chan...! What a coincidence running into you here. Are you out shopping with your Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That's about it.
I thought I'd stock up on seasonings
for the next time I cook with Buena-san.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So that's what happened...!
Hehe, Cesario really is thoughtful, isn't she?
choice_data_list: Do the two of you often cook together?
Do you two cook together often?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes. We're in the same dorm, so...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I came to make canapés so I could
enjoy them together with Gentile-san, too."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: We were all working on our own things at first, but before long, we got totally hyped up talking about Spe-san!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Even when the food was ready, we hadn't talked enough,
and even after walking all the way to our room, we couldn't stop...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: That's why we promised to cook together again, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! And when we were deciding what to make,
we figured we'd make a lunchbox for Spe-san
to show our support for her upcoming big race...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As they talk, neither of them can stop smiling.
Being in the same year and sharing a mutual
admiration for Special Week, they hit it off right away.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I came looking for a lunch box and some accessories.
If you don't mind the company, want to browse the shops together?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Waah, with pleasure♪ Oh, right,
I also wanted to ask your advice about salad dressing.
You know so much about it, Buena-san!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Paper napkins with a carrot pattern...!
It would look so lovely wrapped around a sandwich♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, sounds good...!
Come to think of it, has the menu already been decided?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you mention before that you wanted to come up
with a menu good for recovering from fatigue?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I want protein, which is essential for muscle repair,
carbs to replenish my energy, and vitamins to boost absorption efficiency, so—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I'm thinking of making easy-to-digest tofu hamburger steaks,
cheese and ham sandwiches, and a colorful vegetable salad."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Replenishing your nutrition should ideally be done
as soon as possible after intense exercise, but...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: My body's tired right after a race, so I want something gentle on the stomach...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as expected!
This menu is packed with Cesario-chan's love.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. Salad is fine and all,
but how about making vegetable skewers?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'll prepare a few mayo-based dressings and make it bagna cauda style.
Your hands won't get dirty, so it's super easy to eat!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That's lovely!
Then let's buy some extra food picks too—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chatting cheerfully about this and that,
the two of them bought everything needed to make the bento.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Now we just have to make it.
Hehe, I can't wait to watch Spe-san's race."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I just can't wait!
Spe-san's running is so powerful,
it really gives me energy!
choice_data_list: So you both really admire her, huh.
So you both really admire her, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That powerful, razor-sharp late spurt fit for the "Supreme Commander of Japan"...
No matter how many times I see it, it makes my heart race!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I totally get that.
When I watched Spe-san's Japan Cup,
I found myself crying tears of deep emotion before I even realized it...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup...! I know what you mean!
I still get goosebumps just thinking about it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cesario sometimes has Special Week accompany her
for match races, and her expression during those runs
is always brimming with life.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because they love and respect them that they yearn so strongly to support and aid them.
The boxed lunches the two of them make are sure to turn out wonderful.
choice_data_list: I hope their feelings reach them.
I hope their feelings reach them.
Spe will definitely be thrilled with this bento.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because they love and respect them that they yearn so strongly to support and aid them.
The boxed lunches the two of them make are sure to turn out wonderful.
choice_data_list: I hope their feelings reach them.
I hope their feelings reach them.
Spe will definitely be thrilled with this bento.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That's true.
Because for an Umamusume, her feelings are so important...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I hope our cheering gives Spe-san the push she needs to keep going!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Spe-san will surely take it all in stride.
She's the kind of Umamusume who can turn everyone's support into her own strength, after all.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That's true.
Since it's Spe-san, I'm sure she will...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I hope she likes it.
I just love watching Spe-san eat with such gusto♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Me too!
They look so happy eating with such gusto,
just watching them puts a smile on your face."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's put our backs into it and make a whole bunch!
Let's do our best, Buena-san!
